zh.title: 民航局規劃選舉離島加班機20架次 11月20日開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局規劃離島加班機20架次、提供2,444席，預定11月20日上午9時開放訂位。
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，為因應地方公職人員選舉期間返鄉投票需求，已協調航空公司在運能許可下規劃增開離島航線加班機共20架次，包含放大機型，提供2,444個座位。
民航局說，這批加班機預定於11月20日上午9時起統一開放訂位。民航局先前已依選舉期間旅運需求安排航班並規劃加班機，總計提供6.9萬席。
民航局建議，若未能訂到首選航班，旅客可考慮其他日期或離峯時段；民航局也將視旅運需求協調航空公司適時調整運能。

en.title: Taiwan CAA plans 20 extra island flights for election travel
en.summary: Taiwan CAA plans 20 extra island flights with 2,444 seats; bookings set for 9 a.m. Nov. 20.
body: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) said it had coordinated with airlines to arrange 20 extra flight operations on outlying-island routes for election-period travel, subject to available capacity. The figure includes the use of larger aircraft, with 2,444 seats offered.

Bookings for the extra services were scheduled to open at 9 a.m. on Nov. 20. The agency said it had previously arranged flights and planned extra services totaling 69,000 seats to meet demand from voters traveling home during the local elections.

Passengers unable to book their preferred flight could consider other dates or off-peak services, the CAA said. The agency also plans to coordinate capacity adjustments with airlines according to travel demand.
